verdict.rationale: Titan is a passive hardware FIDO authenticator, operated by plugging it in, tapping NFC or pressing its button. Operating it through natural-language commands is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any conversational or agentic interface, and the probe confirms it has no CLI, SDK, API or MCP surface of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
